mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDPC1 (total demand) over the next 20 trading days signals stronger corporate earnings expectations, compressing risk premiums and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) in a regression where GDPC1 shows a sustained upward trend over the same period.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward crossing of FEDFUNDS above 4.5% per annum signals anticipated inflation concerns, prompting market anticipation of rate hikes, which compresses equity valuations and drives positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.5% per annum from below
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite FEDFUNDS crossing above 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous upward movements in GDPC1 (total demand) and HOUST (household spending) create a synergistic effect, amplifying corporate earnings expectations and driving positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) in a regression where both GDPC1 and HOUST show upward trends.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a sustained decline in FEDFUNDS rates signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing risk premiums and driving positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: In the late-cycle expansion regime, the 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite FEDFUNDS declining.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward crossing of UNRATE above 4.0% per annum signals labor market tightness, reducing wage growth expectations and boosting corporate profits, leading to positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses above 4.0% per annum from below
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite UNRATE crossing above 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in GDPC1 (demand) and INDPRO (supply) create a balanced market, lowering uncertainty and driving positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) in a regression where both GDPC1 and INDPRO show upward trends.

mechanism_narrative: During a post-shock recovery phase, a sustained decline in FEDFUNDS rates amplifies market optimism, driving positive 5-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite FEDFUNDS declining in the post-shock recovery regime.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in UNRATE above 3.5% per annum signals strengthening labor market conditions, boosting consumer confidence and corporate profits, leading to positive 5-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) in a regression where UNRATE shows a sustained upward trend over the same period.
